nameZh: IPIP积极情绪表达9题（研究译稿）
attribution: Barchard (2001), as attributed by the official IPIP key; do not claim a complete emotional-intelligence battery.

items.zh: 我会用身体接触来表达亲近和喜爱。

items.en: Laugh out loud if something is funny.
items.zh: 遇到有趣的事，我会放声笑出来。

items.en: Express my happiness in a childlike manner.
items.zh: 我会像孩子一样表达自己的快乐。

items.en: Sometimes laugh out loud when reading or watching TV.
items.zh: 看书或看电视时，我有时会放声笑出来。

items.en: Show my feelings when I'm happy.
items.zh: 开心时，我会把自己的感受表现出来。

items.en: Find it difficult showing people that I care about them.
items.zh: 我觉得很难向别人表达我在乎他们。
我难以表达亲近和喜爱。

items.en: Keep my happy feelings to myself.
items.zh: 我把开心的感受留在心里，不表现出来。

reliability.interpretation: Official English-source group coefficients, women N=432 and men N=317; not evidence of Chinese reliability, individual accuracy or normative thresholds.

construct: Self-reported outward expression of positive feelings and affection; not happiness level, emotion-regulation ability, social competence or relationship quality.

feedback.summary: 这份回答帮助你观察：开心和亲近的感受，通常会怎样被别人看见？它关注表达习惯，而不是你过得有多快乐。
feedback.direction: 计分方向越高，表示你越常通过笑声、表情或亲近动作表达积极感受；较少外露也不代表冷漠或不在乎。
feedback.reflection: 回想最近一次开心的事：你是笑出声、说出来，还是安静地享受？身边的人是否知道你的心情？
feedback.action: 选一个自己舒服、对方也愿意接受的方式，分享一件小开心或说一句感谢；表达亲近不必依赖拥抱或身体接触。
feedback.limits: 表达方式受文化、关系边界和情境影响。该中文译稿尚待审核与验证，无可用的项目常模或分界值；不能用于诊断、能力排名或考核。

population: 成人研究使用边界；非中文效度声明

versionNote: Current official key as accessed 2026-10-25; not the old 10-item form.
family: IPIP scales measuring seven components potentially related to emotional intelligence (Barchard, 2001); this isolated component is not a full emotional-intelligence test and is not another proprietary instrument.
